description: Presidential Secretariat - The Urban Development Project (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 1980 - D/S Division, Maharagama
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for an urban development project. It declares that specific parcels of land are required for a Mixed Development Project under the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act. The document includes detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, lot numbers, extents, and locations. While it mentions the President and a Minister, the core content is about land matters rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
